messages:
marta: Quick ask — we need approval to buy a short-term shared GPU pool (6 months) to cover an enterprise pilot and some bursty CI runs. Proposal: allocate a 24 A100-equivalent monthly capacity pool across us-west2 + eu-west1 and use spot/backfill + hosted fallback. Spreadsheet with numbers: https://redwoodco.share/spreadsheets/pu-6mo-pool (see tab 'proposal').

raj: +1 on the idea. Rough numbers from infra model: on-demand run-rate at peak = ~$85k/mo. 6mo reserved blend = ~$60k/mo. 12mo reserved = ~$48k/mo. If we consolidate across regions and enable spot fallback we estimate effective cost ~ $55k/mo. I pasted the quick calc in the sheet.

alex: question — does this reduce our Dedicated reserved headroom? If we reuse Dedicated machines we might violate isolation SLAs for some enterprise customers. Need to be explicit that this is a separate pool, or we run it on separate tenancy.

marta: Yes — separate tenancy. The ask is for a short-lived "shared-burst" pool under infra budget (not customer-dedicated). We'll gate per-customer caps and route high-SLA traffic to Dedicated/Dedicated-burst which remains untouched.

chris: Finance check — need GL code + confirmation of cashflow impact to Q2/Q3. Also what's the cancellation/true-up policy? 6mo commitments sometimes have nasty early termination terms. Can you add the vendor contract excerpt to the sheet?

raj: added vendor terms snippet in the sheet and pasted summary here: "6mo partial-commit: 60% refund up to 30 days, then fixed for remainder; prorated if we downscale after month 3." Not ideal but better than on-demand for expected utilization.

billing-bot: current committed GPUs: us-west2=12, eu-west1=0; projected additional commit (6mo pool): us-west2=16, eu-west1=8. Estimated monthly delta vs today: +$34,000.

alex: ops note — network egress between regions will add ~3-5% to tco if model shards move. Keep heavier models pinned to region of traffic. Also we should enable QoS on inter-region links during pilot windows.

marta: action items: (1) raj to finalize the model/usage forecast and add confidence bands by EOD tomorrow, (2) chris to confirm GL and signoff path, (3) legal to review cancellation terms (i'll ping them). If finance signs off we want to submit the purchase request next week.

chris: will check with FP&A — please put a short one-pager justification in the sheet (2 bullets: revenue pilot + reduce p95 latency/regression risk). I'll escalate if numbers look right.

raj: tiny calc snippet I pasted:
```
on_demand = 85_000
6mo_commit = 60_000
12mo_commit = 48_000
net_savings_vs_on_demand = on_demand - 6mo_commit # = 25_000/mo
annualized_if_12mo = on_demand - 12mo_commit # = 37_000/mo
```

marta: thanks — tagging legal and product offline. If anyone sees a blocker call it out here. :thumbsup:
